78c466.title: Secrets & SCA scan results (backend static pass)
78c466.content:
Static supply-chain/secrets pass complete on /workspace/agentcore-superagent-update (artifacts in /workspace/.source-aware: opengrep.json, gitleaks.json, trufflehog.json, trivy-fs.json, ast-grep.json).

Hardcoded auth secrets:
- JWT_SECRET default 'super-agent-local-dev-secret-change-in-production' (backend/src/config/index.ts:30) — already reported by another agent (vuln-0001), deduplicated.
- INSFORGE_JWT_SECRET default 'spike-test-secret-key-must-be-32-chars-long' (config/index.ts:145, used in routes/apps.routes.ts:453 HMAC token minting) — filed as vuln-0008 (high).

Secrets scans (gitleaks/trufflehog): no production secrets. Only PoC/example creds in app-hosting poc k8s manifests, docker-compose (postgres:postgres etc.), .env.example placeholders, node_modules fixtures.

SCA: 402 CVEs across manifests, mostly low/medium or in PoC/node_modules. Backend reachability triage by import analysis:
- Filed: js-yaml CVE-2026-53550 (vuln-0009, reachable — user YAML in api-spec-parser.service.ts:183 via integrations.routes.ts:70), nodemailer CVE-2026-82662 (vuln-0012, reachable — email.service.ts), fastify CVE-2026-84504 (vuln-0013, reachable — framework on all requests), ws CVE-2026-48779 (vuln-0011, not_applicable — type-only import, backend uses @fastify/websocket).
- No backend/src imports: fast-xml-parser (critical CVEs — only PoC services use it), axios, protobufjs (critical), mysql2, hono, undici, minimatch, brace-expansion, fast-uri, form-data, effect, defu, deepmerge-ts, source-map-js, lodash.
- Frontend xlsx 0.18.5 (CVE-2023-30533, CVE-2024-22363 prototype pollution + ReDoS) not filed — no source-level import check performed (open item).
- Other manifests (agentcore, app-hosting poc, infra) not deeply triaged — 208 misconfig findings (Docker/K8s hardening) not reported individually.

ast-grep structural pass run on 250 backend/src files (sg-targets.txt derived from backend sources; opengrep scope covered whole repo).
